∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Kernel.StreamWrite.Deployment} {directory : Minidregg.Theory.CellRegistry.Directory ℕ Minidregg.Kernel.StreamWrite.Registry} {headCellId sequence : ℕ} {entry : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Entry}, Minidregg.Kernel.StreamWrite.entryAt deployment directory headCellId sequence = Option.some entry → entry.head = headCellId ∧ entry.sequence = sequence

∀ (entry : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Entry), (Minidregg.Kernel.StreamWrite.entryWrite entry).cellId = { value := Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.entryCellId entry.head entry.sequence } ∧ (Minidregg.Kernel.StreamWrite.entryWrite entry).expectedPre = Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceBirthCodec.physicalRoot Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceBirthCodec.LifecycleImage.fresh ∧ (Minidregg.Kernel.StreamWrite.entryWrite entry).canonicalPostBytes = Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceBirthCodec.LifecycleImage.bytes Minidregg.Kernel.StreamWrite.Registry (Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceBirthCodec.LifecycleImage.live (Minidregg.Kernel.StreamWrite.entryCell entry))

∀ (cellId : ℕ) (pre : Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceBirthCodec.LifecycleImage Minidregg.Kernel.StreamWrite.Registry) (post : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Head), Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceBirthCodec.rootBytes (Minidregg.Kernel.StreamWrite.headWrite cellId pre post).canonicalPostBytes = (Minidregg.Kernel.StreamWrite.headWrite cellId pre post).exactPost

∀ (deployment : Minidregg.Kernel.StreamWrite.Deployment) (directory : Minidregg.Theory.CellRegistry.Directory ℕ Minidregg.Kernel.StreamWrite.Registry) (headCellId : ℕ) (head : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Head) (start count sequence : ℕ) (entry : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Entry), (sequence, entry) ∈ Minidregg.Kernel.StreamWrite.window deployment directory headCellId head start count ↔ start ≤ sequence ∧ sequence < start + count ∧ 1 ≤ sequence ∧ sequence ≤ head.count ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.StreamWrite.entryAt deployment directory headCellId sequence = Option.some entry
